facts.fact: The World Bank mid-term aide-memoire says all technical operations of the PFSS-RRC cash transfer project, from targeting to payment statements, are already digitalised and its Management Information System (Beneficiary Management Platform, Complaints Platform, Internal Management Platform) is already available.
facts.system: PFSS-RRC MIS (Plateforme de Gestion des Beneficiaires)

facts.fact: The World Bank mid-term aide-memoire reports 41,703 beneficiaries receiving payments by mobile money, and says ARIEP beneficiaries hold accounts with Sanduk and are all paid by bank transfer.
facts.system: PFSS-RRC MIS (Plateforme de Gestion des Beneficiaires)
